production_source_provenance: Production sources were unchanged during initial component measurements; naive_source_commit identifies their exact Git blobs.
datakey_note: wrapped datakey endpoint measured with temporary svc-migration token (900s), revoked after measurement; adapter instead generates a local CSPRNG DEK then wraps it.
sql_note: sql_plain component measures full-profile driver round trip using bench_user without TLS; protected server db_time is separately anchored by pg_stat_statements from naive_v1.

db_time.scope: Top-level SQL for the workload role/database only; execution, excluding planning, network and crypto
db_time.percentiles: NOT_AVAILABLE: cumulative execution counters do not provide p50/p95

interpretation.cross_domain_unwrap_note: PII and FIN use distinct Transit key paths; not combined into one decrypt batch. No weaker key separation introduced.
interpretation.cpu_note: Naive first protected read_by_nik OpenBao median 54.02% of one core, peak 79.36%; client median 113% of one core. Micro-case CPU samples are short and not evidence of server saturation. Network/TLS HTTP framing and client/server scheduling are included in RPC times.
interpretation.bounded_cache_justification: Pool already reuses TLS. Insert HMAC batch reduces RPCs but does not reduce the three-RPC full read path. Therefore optional existing bounded DEK cache is evaluated, without caching plaintext or blind-index values.
interpretation.locking: OpenBaoClient holds a per-client RLock over the HTTP call, but each benchmark worker has its own client, so no shared OpenBao lock serializes all eight workers. PII and FIN calls remain serial within a request.
interpretation.streaming_logging: Runner has persistent PostgreSQL sessions and buffered per-worker CSV logging; no per-request connect or shared synchronous CSV lock.
